URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andraemon

Status Code: 200

Content:
Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)

* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Content:
Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)

* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Content:
Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)

Andraemon

In [Greek mythology](./Greek_mythology "Greek mythology") the name **Andraemon** ([/ænˈdriːmən/](./Help:IPA/English "Help:IPA/English"); [Ancient Greek](./Ancient_Greek_language "Ancient Greek language"): Ἀνδραίμων, [romanized](./Romanization_of_Ancient_Greek "Romanization of Ancient Greek"): *Andraímon*) may refer to:

* Andraemon, son of [Oxylus](./Oxylus "Oxylus") and husband of [Dryope](./Dryope_(daughter_of_Dryops) "Dryope (daughter of Dryops)").[[1]](./Andraemon#cite_note-1)
* Andraemon, possible father of another Oxylus.[[2]](./Andraemon#cite_note-2)
* Andraemon, an [Aetolian](./Aetolia "Aetolia") king and husband of [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)") of [Calydon](./Calydon "Calydon"). By the latter, he became the father of [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"). Andraemon succeeded his father-in-law [Oeneus](./Oeneus "Oeneus")' power over [Aetolia](./Aetolia "Aetolia"). He and his wife were buried in one tomb which was shown in the city of [Amphissa](./Amfissa "Amfissa").[[3]](./Andraemon#cite_note-3)
* Andraemon, brother of [Leonteus](./Leonteus_(mythology) "Leonteus (mythology)"). He married [Amphinome](./Amphinome "Amphinome"), a daughter of [Pelias](./Pelias "Pelias").[[4]](./Andraemon#cite_note-4)
* Andraemon, one of the [Suitors](./Suitors_of_Penelope "Suitors of Penelope") of [Penelope](./Penelope "Penelope") who came from [Dulichium](./Dulichium "Dulichium") along with other 56 wooers.[[5]](./Andraemon#cite_note-5) He, with the other suitors, was slain by [Odysseus](./Odysseus "Odysseus") with the aid of [Eumaeus](./Eumaeus "Eumaeus"), [Philoetius](./Philoetius_(Odyssey) "Philoetius (Odyssey)"), and [Telemachus](./Telemachus "Telemachus").[[6]](./Andraemon#cite_note-6)
* Andraemon, a son of King [Codrus](./Codrus "Codrus"). He participated in the colonization of [Asia Minor](./Asia_Minor "Asia Minor") and drove the [Carians](./Caria "Caria") out of the city of Lebedus. His tomb was shown near [Colophon](./Colophon_(city) "Colophon (city)").[[7]](./Andraemon#cite_note-7) [Mimnermus](./Mimnermus "Mimnermus") related that Andraemon was a native of [Pylos](./Pylos "Pylos") and founder of Colophon.[[8]](./Andraemon#cite_note-8)

Similarly **Andraemonides** was a [patronymic](./Patronymic "Patronymic"), frequently used to refer to [Thoas](./Thoas_(king_of_Aetoila) "Thoas (king of Aetoila)"), son of Andraemon and [Gorge](./Gorge_(mythology) "Gorge (mythology)").[[9]](./Andraemon#cite_note-9)
